body:
Fixes #335

## Summary

This ports the reliability fixes that upstream [anomalyco/opencode](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode) made after our fork point (`0068cb305f`, 2025-11-19, up to `d93568f334`) to the tools, session loop, provider layer and MCP client we already have. **No tools were added.** Each fix applies to code we already have, and each has a regression test.

Upstream moved its code twice since the fork (to Effect services, then from `packages/opencode` to `packages/core`), so no upstream commit could be cherry-picked. I listed all 900 upstream `fix` commits that touch tools, session, provider or MCP code (`docs/case-studies/issue-335/data/`), triaged each one as PORT, ALREADY-HAVE or N/A (`analysis/A–D`), and re-implemented the PORT items in JS. Where a defect also exists in the Rust port, it is fixed in Rust too.

Full case study, including the requirements, timeline, method, online research, libraries considered and verification: [`docs/case-studies/issue-335/`](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/tree/issue-335-cc63abda9307/docs/case-studies/issue-335).

## What changed

### Edit and write (JS + Rust)

| Defect | Upstream | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Parallel edits of one file lost updates | #4388, #23483 | Per-file lock (`FileTime.withLock`) for `edit` and `write` |
| Loose fuzzy match could replace unrelated code; empty `oldString` overwrote a file | #30932 | Stricter thresholds, size guard, explicit error |
| CRLF / mixed endings / UTF-8 BOM not preserved | #9443, #53166, #23797 | Endings and BOM kept; untouched lines never rewritten |
| `replaceAll` interpreted `$&`, `$1` | — | Literal replacement |
| False "modified since read" (clock comparison, `dir/./a` vs `dir/a`) | #17835, #20367 | `{mtime, size}` stamp, canonical path keys |
| `edit` right after `write` failed; empty tool output | `66f9bdab32` | `write` records a read; short confirmations |

### Read, grep, glob, ls (JS + Rust)

| Defect | Upstream | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `glob`/`ls` hung after 100 results (rg blocked on a full pipe) | #10833 | Stream cancelled and rg killed; abort passed through |
| `grep` dropped all matches when one path was unreadable (rg exit 2) | #8612 | Matches kept, plus a note |
| `grep` deadlock on large stderr, no cancel, hidden files skipped | #39238, #7501 | Pipes drained together, abort + 30 s timeout, `--hidden` without `.git` |
| `read` relative to the worktree root, unbounded output, whole file read for the binary check, `\r` leaked | `6cf2c3e3db`, #14009, #51011 | Session directory, 50 KB cap, 4 KB sample, CRLF split |
| macOS screenshot names (U+202F, curly quotes) "not found" | #45807, #50953 | Unique entry matched after canonicalizing |

### Bash and web tools (JS + Rust)

| Defect | Upstream | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bash` ran `/bin/sh` (dash), so bash syntax failed | #3494, #5205 | `$SHELL` if usable, otherwise bash (zsh on macOS) |
| Long output kept the start and dropped the end, where errors are; UTF-8 split (Rust panic) | #22660, #39403 | Tail kept on character boundaries |
| `echo x > file` passed an `echo*` allow rule in read-only/plan mode | #6737 | Write redirects checked as a separate `>` command |
| Rust `bash` deadlocked on full stderr and lost output on timeout | (found here) | Concurrent pipes, partial output, signal reported |
| Web tools: timeout did not cover the body; 5 MB limit checked only after reading it all; Cloudflare 403; Exa key ignored | #21378, #33259, #10328, #16362 | `AbortSignal.timeout`, bounded streaming reader, one honest retry, shared Exa client |
| `Tool.define` stacked wrappers on each init; `task` leaked its subscription | #16952, #9992 | Copy before wrap; `try/finally` |

### Session loop, provider transforms, MCP (JS only; Rust has none of these yet)

| Defect | Upstream | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Context overflow (400 "prompt is too long", 413, `context_length_exceeded`) ended the session | #6480, #14707 | `ContextOverflowError` → compact and continue; a second overflow stops with a clear error |
| Finish `stop` after tool calls ended the loop before the results were sent back | #14973, #26178 | Loop continues while the last step has completed tool calls |
| Retryable 5xx stream errors, plain-text rate limits, Vertex exhaustion, OpenAI item 404, `ZlibError` not retried | #12768, #10590, #24063, #19104 | Classified as retryable; delays capped at 2³¹−1 ms |
| `retry-after` beyond the retry timeout: `process()` returned `undefined` and the loop started another step | (found here) | Normal final-error path, turn stops; retry-only errors added to the message error union (saving them threw a `ZodError`) |
| Lone surrogates, empty Anthropic/Bedrock blocks, empty user messages, foreign signatures/reasoning → 400 | #25934, #4811, `021e42c0bb1`, #21370 | Sanitized per target model |
| Shallow-spread cache options, wrong Bedrock cache point, Moonshot schema errors | #10323, #11664, #18959, #24730, #11984 | `mergeDeep`, `cachePoint: { type: 'default' }`, schema fixes |
| Interrupted tools lost their start time; raw string tool input broke Gemini; tool events without `tool-input-start` dropped | #27254, #21709 | `interrupted` marker, `{ value }` wrapping, `ensureToolCall` |
| Reasoning tokens charged twice; Anthropic thinking budget branch never ran | #21047, (found here) | Charged once; `model.npm` passed |
| MCP: no connect or `tools/list` timeout, endless pagination, sequential listing, leaked failed clients, silent removal on bad URL, no-tools servers failed, results without `content` dropped, timed-out calls kept running, `_` in server names broke per-tool timeouts, connect timeout was `NaN`, grandchildren left on dispose | #6760, #19200, #31442, #13229, #25019, #31595, #31271, #7879, #32244, #15516 | All fixed; see §6.3 of the case study |
| `cancel()` rejected queued callers with `undefined` | `6c9b2c37a5` | `AbortError` |

## Review follow-up: compatibility, memory, Rust parity

Answer to the review comment ("not break anything previously working … configuration for breaking changes … memory leaks … parity between JavaScript and Rust"). Details: §11 of the case study and the audits in `experiments/issue-335/audit/`.

**Backward compatibility.** The JSON input format, event types and envelope are unchanged; stored sessions still load. Every change a script or model could notice has a switch that restores the previous behaviour, as a CLI flag and a `LINK_ASSISTANT_AGENT_*` env var (JS `src/config/config.ts`, Rust `src/compat.rs`):

| Change | Restore previous behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| bash runs `$SHELL` (if POSIX) or bash instead of `/bin/sh` | `--bash-shell legacy` (or a path) |
| bash keeps the tail of long output; edit/write return a confirmation; read past EOF is an error | `--legacy-tool-output` |
| edit refuses loose fuzzy matches and an empty `oldString` on an existing file | `--legacy-edit-matching` |
| glob/ls do not follow symlinked directories | `--glob-follow-symlinks` |
| grep searches hidden files and stops after 30 s | `--no-grep-hidden`, `--grep-timeout-ms 0` |
| read returns at most 2000 lines / 50 KB | `--read-max-lines 0`, `--read-max-bytes 0` |
| context overflow is reported as `ContextOverflowError` | `--legacy-error-names` (non-retryable `APIError`, as before) |
| `tokens.output` excludes reasoning tokens | `--legacy-token-usage` |
| a `stop` finish after tool calls continues the loop | `--legacy-loop-exit` |
| MCP connect is bounded (30 s) | `--mcp-connect-timeout 0` or per-server `connect_timeout` |

MCP `timeout` keeps its old meaning (tools listing); connect got its own `connect_timeout` so that a short listing timeout no longer cuts a slow connect. `js/tests/compat-flags.ts` runs every switch in both states and checks the env wiring in a child process; the Rust switches are tested through `ToolContext::with_settings`.

**Memory and resource leaks fixed (JS):** unbounded SSE usage map; the usage tee branch that stopped reading and made the tee buffer the rest of the stream; bash output and abort-listener retention; grep buffering all rg output; FileTime stamps after a session is deleted; continuous/single-shot mode waiting forever for `session.idle` when a prompt failed early; retried 5xx/429 bodies not cancelled; retry `sleep` abort listener; `withTimeout` timer on rejection; `Instance.dispose()` leaving the cache entry; pending permission asks of a cancelled turn. Each has a regression test. Two items were left on purpose (client disconnect does not cancel a turn; the per-request provider timeout signal) — reasons in §11.2.

**Rust parity.** `grep`, `glob`, `list`, `read`, `edit`, `bash`, `todo`, `batch`, `webfetch`, `websearch` now match the JS tools (output, errors, limits; edit diffs checked against output of the JS code), with the same compatibility switches plus `--read-only` / `--disable-tools`. Latent Rust bugs fixed: non-ASCII panic in `permission.rs`, prefix match in `Filesystem::contains`, panic on an empty id. Not done, with reasons: FileTime and the per-file lock (each Rust CLI run is a separate process with no session), permission checks in tools (the Rust CLI never runs tools for a model), and the absent LLM/session/provider/MCP layers (pre-existing). Divergences are listed in `experiments/issue-335/audit/rust-parity-fixes.md`.

**CI checks that also failed on `main`** (fixed here, no manual step; §11.4 of the case study):

- **Security:** `body-parser` 2.3.0 (GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828, high), bumped to 2.4.0 in both lockfiles.
- **Free Model Drift:** Kilo withdrew `nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free`, the default model and first compaction model in JS and Rust. The defaults are now `kilo/nemotron-3-ultra-free` (cascade `(kilo/nemotron-3-ultra-free kilo/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free same)`). For backward compatibility `kilo/nemotron-3-super-free` (and the bare short name) stays accepted as a deprecated alias that runs on Ultra and logs a warning naming the replacement; the drift script skips aliases and checks that their targets are built-ins.
- **Model Catalogue:** `check-default-models.mjs` reported the same withdrawn default; fixed by the new default. The alias warning lives in `kilo-deprecation.ts` so `kilo.ts` stays dependency-free (this workflow runs without installing packages).
- **Dependency Freshness:** all direct npm dependencies bumped to latest (AI SDK and `@ai-sdk/*`, MCP SDK, opentui 0.8, `glob` 14, `minimatch` 11, `hono`, `command-stream` 2.6, …; no source changes needed). `solid-js` unpinned (opentui#689 is closed) and the obsolete `seroval` override dropped. `lino-arguments` stays on 0.3.x and is pinned: 0.4.0 makes the agent exit at startup when the host has both `http_proxy` and `HTTP_PROXY` (reported upstream: link-foundation/lino-arguments#50). Rust: `globset`, `ignore`, `similar` and `uuid` updated to their latest patch releases for `cargo outdated`.

**Crash in git worktrees and submodules (found while checking the dependency refresh).** `Project.fromDirectory` wrote its id cache to `.git/opencode` without awaiting or handling the write. In a worktree or submodule `.git` is a file, so the write rejected with `ENOTDIR` and the `unhandledRejection` handler exited the CLI with code 1, on every run. The id is now cached in the common git dir (as upstream does) and a failed write is only logged. Reproduction: `bun experiments/issue-335/project-worktree.ts <worktree dir>`; regression test `js/tests/project-worktree.ts` fails before the fix and passes after.

## Deliberate deviations from upstream

- **No new tools** (requirement of the issue): `apply_patch`, `lsp`, `question`, `skill`, `plan-*` and `code-mode` were not added. The unregistered `patch` and `multiedit` stay unregistered.
- **`write` keeps "no restrictions"**: upstream requires a prior read; the fork removed that on purpose (`db682c8`).
- **Image formats**: upstream stopped sending SVG/BMP/TIFF/ICO/AVIF as images (#21114). The fork supports them on a maintainer's request (`86f24ac`), so that change was not ported.
- After an overflow compaction, upstream replays the user message; here the existing flow (summary plus a synthetic "Continue if you have next steps") is kept.

Known remaining limitation: when a model overflows, the compaction model cascade does not move on to the next model; the overflow is reported instead.

## How to reproduce (example: lost parallel edits)

```bash
git worktree add /tmp/main origin/main && cp -r experiments/issue-335 /tmp/main/experiments/
ln -s "$PWD/js/node_modules" /tmp/main/js/node_modules
(cd /tmp/main && bun experiments/issue-335/edit-write/01-parallel-edits.ts)
# runs=20 both-fulfilled-but-one-edit-lost=15 rejected=1
bun experiments/issue-335/edit-write/01-parallel-edits.ts
# runs=20 both-fulfilled-but-one-edit-lost=0 rejected=0
```

Other reproductions are in `experiments/issue-335/{edit-write,read-search,bash-web}/`.

## Tests

- New: `js/tests/edit-write-reliability.ts`, `read-search-reliability-{read,search}.ts`, `bash-web-reliability.ts`, `session-reliability.ts`, `provider-transform-reliability.ts`, `mcp-reliability.ts` (with a stdio MCP fixture server), `compat-flags.ts` (every compatibility switch in both states, env wiring, leak regressions), `project-worktree.ts`; Kilo alias tests in `free-model-catalog.ts` / `model-drift.ts`; Rust `rust/tests/compat.rs` and `rust/tests/tool_{edit,write,read,grep,glob,bash,webfetch,websearch,codesearch}.rs` (plus the parity tests).
- `cd js && bun test --timeout 30000 ./tests/*.js ./tests/*.ts`: 1150 pass, 4 todo, 0 fail before the review follow-up; the full suite runs in CI on Linux, macOS and Windows for every push.
- Review follow-up, locally: 10 focused JS files (compat, session, MCP, models, CLI options, AI SDK, project worktree, snapshot) 187 pass, 0 fail; `npm run lint`, `format:check`, `check:file-size` clean; `bun scripts/check-model-drift.mjs` and `node scripts/check-npm-freshness.mjs` exit 0; `npm audit --audit-level=high` clean.
- `cd rust && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test`: clean, 563 pass.

Release notes: `js/.changeset/sync-opencode-stability-fixes.md` (the JS pipeline accepts one changeset per PR, so it also covers the default model, the worktree crash and the dependency refresh); `rust/changelog.d/20261022_220339_sync_opencode_stability_fixes.md`, `20261103_002356_tool_js_parity_and_compat_switches.md`, `20261103_120000_kilo_default_model_withdrawn.md`, `20261103_130000_crate_patch_updates.md`.
